Kristina, saw KlariVis joined the ABA Premier Partner Network and added institutions like INSBANK this year, now past 130 banks.

That kind of momentum usually opens more community banks worth pursuing than the team can work before interest cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for KlariVis off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Kristina, quick follow-up for KlariVis.

With the ABA partnership opening doors, pipeline targets usually climb faster than the sales team can cover. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings KlariVis needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kristina, last bit of proof for KlariVis.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how KlariVis' reply rate likely compares to other bank-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Kristina, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a community-bank motion? I will tailor it to KlariVis either way.
